==Notes==
*[[AI]] activates this [[skill]] as soon as at least one target is within range of the nearest corpse.
*Heroes will only target allies with this spell, not foes.

==Trivia==
*During early alpha, this skill dealt 20 damage to all nearby creatures when exploiting a targeted corpse. It was classified as a "Necromancer Corpse Exploitation Skill" and used to cost 10 energy.
